focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需加速构建碳数据合规体系
focus.summary: 2026年10月，欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期进入最后阶段，2027年起将正式对进口钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力和氢能征收碳关税。中国出口企业须在过渡期内完成产品嵌入碳排放的核算与申报，并建立可追溯的碳数据管理体系。未合规申报可能导致货物滞留或面临罚款。建议企业尽快对接欧盟授权申报人，采用国际认可的方法学开展碳足迹核算，并考虑在合同中明确碳成本分担条款，以降低过渡期后的合规风险与成本冲击。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.10.12
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transition Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Must Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: As of October 2026, the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transition period is in its final phase, with definitive carbon tariffs on imports of steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen set to apply from 2027. Chinese exporters must complete embedded emissions calculation and reporting during the transition and establish a traceable carbon data management system. Non-compliant reporting may lead to cargo delays or penalties. Companies should engage EU authorised declarants promptly, adopt internationally recognised methodologies for carbon footprint accounting, and consider explicit carbon cost-sharing clauses in contracts to mitigate post-transition compliance risks and cost impacts.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国仲裁裁决：跨境仲裁司法审查标准再确认
case.summary: 近期，新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）在一宗涉及中国企业与东南亚公司的货物买卖纠纷中，依据《纽约公约》承认并执行了一份由中国国际经济贸易仲裁委员会（CIETAC）作出的仲裁裁决。法院驳回了被申请人关于仲裁庭组成违反约定及公共政策的抗辩，强调对仲裁裁决的司法审查应保持克制，仅在程序严重瑕疵时方可拒绝执行。该案为中国企业在新加坡及普通法法域申请执行中国仲裁裁决提供了积极指引，建议企业在跨境合同中明确仲裁条款，并注意保留仲裁程序合规证据。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026年第三季度
case.title_en: SICC Recognises and Enforces Chinese Arbitral Award: Judicial Review Standards for Cross-Border Arbitration Reaffirmed
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced an arbitral award issued by the China International Economic and Trade Arbitration Commission (CIETAC) under the New York Convention in a sale of goods dispute between a Chinese company and a Southeast Asian counterparty. The court rejected the respondent's objections regarding tribunal composition and public policy, emphasising that judicial review of arbitral awards should be restrained and enforcement refused only for serious procedural defects. This case offers positive guidance for Chinese enterprises seeking enforcement of Chinese arbitral awards in Singapore and common law jurisdictions. Companies should clearly draft arbitration clauses in cross-border contracts and preserve evidence of procedural compliance.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Commercial Court · Q3 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动便利化新举措，涉外企业数据合规路径进一步明晰
policy.summary: 2026年10月，粤港澳大湾区在数据跨境流动领域推出新一批便利化措施，进一步扩大安全评估、标准合同和个人信息保护认证的适用范围，并试点建立粤港澳数据跨境流动白名单机制。新措施允许符合条件的企业在科研、金融、医疗等特定场景下更高效地开展数据跨境传输，同时强化事中事后监管。对于在大湾区布局的出海企业而言，应借此优化数据合规架构，将数据出境路径纳入常态化合规管理，并关注行业白名单的动态更新，以降低合规成本、提升跨境运营效率。
policy.source: 来源：广东省人民政府、香港特区政府、澳门特区政府联合发布 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches New Measures to Facilitate Cross-Border Data Flows, Clarifying Compliance Pathways for Foreign-Related Enterprises
policy.summary_en: In October 2026, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area introduced a new round of facilitation measures for cross-border data flows, further expanding the application of security assessments, standard contracts and personal information protection certification, and piloting a whitelist mechanism for GBA cross-border data transfers. The measures allow eligible enterprises to conduct cross-border data transmission more efficiently in specific scenarios such as research, finance and healthcare, while strengthening ongoing supervision. For outbound-oriented enterprises in the GBA, this is an opportunity to optimise data compliance structures, integrate data export pathways into routine compliance management, and monitor updates to sectoral whitelists to reduce compliance costs and enhance cross-border operational efficiency.
policy.source_en: Source: Jointly issued by the Guangdong Provincial Government, HKSAR Government and Macao SAR Government · Oct 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华投资限制新规下，企业应重构跨境投资合规与风险隔离机制
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：近期美国进一步收紧对华投资限制，将半导体、人工智能、量子计算等敏感领域纳入禁止或申报范围，并强化对间接投资和合资架构的穿透审查。中国出海企业及在华运营的跨国企业需重新评估跨境投资架构，识别敏感技术流向，建立投资前尽职调查与交易后合规监控机制。建议在交易文件中设置合规陈述保证、分手费与赔偿条款，并利用香港、新加坡等中间控股平台实现风险隔离。同时，应密切关注中国反制措施及双边政策互动，避免双重合规冲突。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 编辑部 · 2026.10.12
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Under New U.S. Outbound Investment Restrictions, Companies Should Rebuild Cross-Border Investment Compliance and Risk Isolation Mechanisms
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The United States has recently further tightened outbound investment restrictions targeting China, adding sensitive sectors such as semiconductors, artificial intelligence and quantum computing to prohibited or notifiable categories, and enhancing look-through scrutiny of indirect investments and joint venture structures. Chinese outbound enterprises and multinationals operating in China must reassess cross-border investment structures, identify sensitive technology flows, and establish pre-investment due diligence and post-closing compliance monitoring mechanisms. It is advisable to include compliance representations and warranties, break fees and indemnities in transaction documents, and to use intermediate holding platforms in Hong Kong or Singapore for risk isolation. Meanwhile, companies should closely monitor China's countermeasures and bilateral policy interactions to avoid dual compliance conflicts.
